actors.name: Owner
actors.private_context: Owner has run Fenwick & Sloane for 31 years and is retiring. She has two deputies: one for buying, one for operations. She has not yet decided who will succeed her as general manager. Her accountant has advised settling the succession before seasonal hires arrive. Staff have started asking openly about the decision.

actors.name: Deputy (Buying)
actors.private_context: Deputy in charge of buying at Fenwick & Sloane. Aware that the owner is retiring and that a successor will be named. Interested in the general manager position.

actors.name: Deputy (Operations)
actors.private_context: Deputy in charge of operations at Fenwick & Sloane. Aware that the owner is retiring and that a successor will be named. Interested in the general manager position.

shared_context: Fenwick & Sloane is a store. The owner is retiring. Holiday trading starts on November 1. The owner has two deputies: one runs buying, the other runs operations. Staff have been asking openly about who will take over. The accountant has advised settling the succession before seasonal hires arrive.

starting_events.description: The simulation begins. The owner has not yet announced a successor. The two deputies are aware of the situation.

resolution: Resolve YES if, before the hard cutoff at 2026-11-01T09:00:00+00:00, the persistent event history shows that the owner has publicly named one of the two deputies as the new general manager. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
